messages:
maria: FYI I'm about to land a versioned proxy that does header-based routing + fallback to legacy. Need to sync on grace-window, telemetry events, and E2E cases. Will post config snippet.

jake: quick q — what's the planned detection order? header -> cookie -> legacy? or header-only?

maria: header first. If X-RW-API-Version present -> route to /vN pool. If missing, we keep legacy. Cookie fallback only for web clients that can't set headers (we're trying to avoid adding cookie logic but may be necessary).

oliver: cookie adds complexity for multi-tenant caches though. Any chance we can map legacy->vX on the client SDKs and avoid cookie magic?

anya: SDK bump is ideal but adoption will be slow. We need a server-side grace path for months. Recommend a 90-day grace window + telemetry to measure adoption per-tenant.

maria: agreed on grace window. proposal: 90 days default, env override per-tenant, and an opt-in header to force vX for testing.

jake: sounds good. What telemetry do we need to decide when to close the window?

maria: metrics: percentage of requests with X-RW-API-Version per tenant, error rates by route (4xx/5xx), latency delta vX vs legacy, and a spike detector for fallback traffic. Also log sample requests that hit fallback.

oliver: add idempotency header audit. If vX changes request shape, we need to catch clients that depend on old idempotency semantics.

anya: +1. Also capture client-agent strings so we can contact heavy users.

maria: here's the config snippet I'll push to the proxy (draft):

```
route:
  match:
    header: X-RW-API-Version
  handler: versioned-pool
fallback:
  handler: legacy-pool
cookie_support: optional
grace_window_days: 90
logging:
  sample_rate: 0.01
```

jake: minor nit: sample_rate 1% may miss small tenants. Maybe per-tenant sampling floor of 5 events/day.

maria: ok will add per-tenant floor.

ci-bot: integration-tests/compat-proxy started (job 4123). Results expected ~ 20m.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging queued: canary=10% -> staging cluster infra-stg-3.

oliver: for E2E, we need test vectors: missing header, header with unsupported version, header with malformed value, cookie-only, mixed tenant headers. Also streaming cases (chunked) where header presence matters mid-stream.

anya: add a regression test that verifies fallback header is recorded in traces and that we emit a deprecation notice header back to client: X-RW-API-Deprecation: v0->v1 (date).

maria: good call. We'll emit a Deprecation header when legacy is used and versioned pool exists. Do we want rate-limited notices so we don't flood clients?

jake: rate-limit notices per-tenant, not per-request. e.g., one notice per tenant per hour.

maria: noted.

oliver: question about backward compatibility: if v1 response schema removes a field, should proxy mutably add it when routing to legacy clients? Seems risky.

anya: we should avoid field munging in proxy. Better to keep compatibility at app-layer or provide a compatibility shim as a service that can be version-aware and do safe transforms.

maria: agreed. Proxy will only route and add headers/logs. No payload transforms. We'll build a separate compat-shim microservice for any necessary rewrites (opt-in).

jake: rollout plan suggestion: 1) staging validate, 2) 10% canary with telemetry hooks, 3) 50% watch, 4) open opt-in migration docs + support playbook, 5) close window per-tenant when adoption >= 95% for 14 days.

maria: I like that. Action items:
- maria: land proxy config + per-tenant sampling (today)
- jake: add telemetry dashboards and spike alert (tomorrow)
- oliver: create E2E test vectors and add to CI (this week)
- anya: draft tenant migration email + support playbook (this week)

anya: I'll also add a support-runbook note about how to temporarily flip tenant routing if something breaks.

maria: thanks all. I'll post the PR link when it's ready. ping me in thread if you see odd staging traffic.

deploy-bot: canary deploy complete: 10% -> success. monitor: infra-stg-3.

jake: saw a small latency bump (~6ms p95) for versioned pool, looks acceptable. keeping an eye.

oliver: CI failed one E2E case for streaming without header, investigating now.

maria: thx — drop the failing logs here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
